Lemma
[Covariant derivatives of the heat error] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0243, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0244, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0245 ↗ lem:chow-iii-ch23-recursive-formula 1. ch23:23.10\group Parametrix

For every $k,\ell \ge 0$ and $T>0$, \[ |\partial _t^\ell \nabla _x^k(\Box _xH_N)| \le C(t-u)^{N-n/2-k-2\ell } e^{-d(x,y)^2/4(t-u)}. \] If $N>n/2+k+2\ell $, then the left side equals \[ (4\pi )^{-n/2}(t-u)^{N-n/2-k-2\ell }e^{-d^2/4(t-u)} \widetilde F_{k,\ell }(x,y,t-u) \] for a smooth covariant tensor $\widetilde F_{k,\ell }$.
Proof

\sketch Differentiate $(\Box _xH_N)=E(\Delta _x\phi _N)(t-u)^N$. Each spatial derivative costs at most one power of $(t-u)^{-1}$ and each time derivative at most two. On a finite atlas, boundedness of the coefficients and their derivatives gives the asserted uniform estimate and the smooth remainder tensor.

□
